name: TO_DUNROBIN_ROAD_WHITE_LONG
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the white edge and edge + black border (6 / 18 = edge 6 + border 12), as the AS 1743 drawings. R9-SA55-1A (450 x 300) illustrated (B 600 x 400, C 750 x 500), R50, 6 / 18. TO 45 E (186/78/186); road name two lines 50 'E>C', max. dimension 360. '= offset' / '= gap' measured on the drawing: TO top 46, lines 121.5 and 201 (bottom 48) -> offset 47, gap 30 (47+45+30+50+30+50+48 = 300). Road name DUNROBIN ROAD is the sheet's example (grey), drawn black. Only used with R2-6.
